vellum_obligation: Carry the format-agnostic inline image path into Vellum's native rendering asset path when the corresponding Pulp target adopts Vellum: inline images in any decodable format (base64 or percent-encoded data URIs) and sprite strips held as encoded bytes draw through the content-keyed inline image entry, sized from a header-only read; undecodable payloads are tried once into a placeholder, decodable sprite frames are bounded by the declared strip size, and raw RGBA strips by their byte count.
